neighbours.label: ' optical' or ' light' before 'microscope' or a lens
fire: These cells are too small for a powerful optical microscope.
Starch grains were counted under an optical microscope.
The new camera does not use optical lenses at all.
We tracked each cell under a light microscope for hours.
The students used a simple light microscope in class.
A modern optical microscope has several lenses.
Diatoms show up clearly under a light microscope.
Her tool still relies on optical lenses and mirrors.
quiet: These cells are too small for a powerful electron microscope.

The students used a simple paper chart in class.
A modern electron microscope has several detectors.
Diatoms show up clearly under an electron microscope.
Her tool still relies on magnets and coils.

notes: 'optical fiber' reached 0.27 in a probe, so the word alone reads somewhat. ' powerful' reached 0.31 before 'electron microscopes'.
